decisions.decision: The Board reviewed the draft Findings and found them complete; Mr. Bakaysa noted the Findings will be revised to note that some abutters felt the Special Permit should not be issued.
decisions.quote: board reviewed draft findings and found them to be complete.

decisions.decision: Board consensus was for 200 hours/year for sawmill operation, and to change the hours of operation from 9 to 3.
decisions.quote: board consensus was for 200 hours/year. also change hours of operation from 9 to 3.

decisions.decision: Add a Directive requiring a mechanism that provides restricted access when the sawmill is not in use.
decisions.quote: add directive that states there must be a mechanism that provides restricted access when not in use.

decisions.decision: Delete Directives 12 and 14 and put a renewal clause in their place; the permit to lapse and be subject to renewal by the Planning Board.
decisions.quote: delete 12. and 14. - put in renewal clause instead.

decisions.decision: Directive 14 to be reworded so violations are addressed by the Zoning Official through appropriate legal means, on Town Counsel's advice that revoking a special permit is problematic.
decisions.quote: any violations of this order shall be addressed by the zoning official through appropriate legal means

decisions.decision: Mr. Bakaysa and Mr. Lockwood want a closer review of noise limits at item 4; Mr. Bakaysa wants the most noise restriction that can be put on at the boundary line, and more research is needed.
decisions.quote: mr. bakaysa wants to know most noise restriction that can be put on at the boundary line. more research needed.

decisions.decision: The Board will open the hearing Monday night to give the date of continuation and then adjourn the hearing.
decisions.quote: board will open hearing monday night for purpose of giving date of continuation and then adjourn hearing.
